sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: When you send an enquiry, we collect the details you enter: name, phone number, email, city and your message. We do not ask for payment details on this website.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: We use your details only to reply to your enquiry, prepare quotations and follow up about your order. We do not sell your information.

sections.heading: Third-party services
sections.body: Enquiry forms are delivered to us by email through a form service (Formspree), and WhatsApp messages go through WhatsApp. Images are served by ImageKit. These services process data under their own privacy policies.
